topic_label: Commitment to integrity and ethical values
control_description: Code of conduct with confidentiality duties; POL-05 acknowledgment; sanctions under POL-01 4.13
evidence: Code of conduct; acknowledgment report (97% office staff; Digital Services 12 of 12)

control_description: Board audit committee receives quarterly cyber risk reports from the vCISO, including FMS readiness from 2026-Q4
gap: Only one quarterly report on record; FMS not yet a standing item
remediation: Minute each quarterly report through the observation period with an FMS section

control_description: Reporting lines: Director of Digital Services owns the FMS; Security Manager owns security; roles in POL-01
Hiring checks and annual training. FMS engineers have no secure development training
gap: No role-based secure development training for FMS engineers
remediation: Secure development training under STD-10

control_description: Owners named for every FMS control; quarterly security review
gap: Control owner list for the FMS not yet approved
remediation: Approve the FMS control matrix with owners

control_description: FMS component inventory and model registry exist; data flow diagram for the FMS account
gap: Inventory does not yet include third-party libraries (no SBOM)
remediation: SBOM for each FMS release (POAM-017)

topic_label: Internal communication of objectives and responsibilities
control_description: Policies published to staff on the intranet; Digital Services briefed on POL-01 to POL-05 in 2026-09
gap: FMS-specific procedures (on-call, change, recovery) not yet written
remediation: Write and publish the FMS operating procedures

control_description: Subscription agreements state security and availability commitments; status page exists. No security contact for subscribers and no tested notice procedure
gap: Subscribers have no published security contact; the 72-hour notice and the addendum notices have never been exercised (P03 G-095)
remediation: Public security contact (2026-11-15); notice templates; quarterly notice drill (POAM-018)

topic_label: Objectives specified to enable risk identification
control_description: Objectives for the FMS stated in the BIA (BP-14) and subscription commitments
Enterprise risk assessment includes FMS risks (P01 R-024 to R-028)
Fraud risk considered for the FMS (false data injection, misuse of advisories)
Significant changes reviewed at the change advisory board for the ERP; FMS model and release changes are not
gap: FMS changes not assessed for security impact
remediation: Add FMS releases and model updates to the change process (POAM-019)

control_description: Annual co-sourced assessment (P07); FMS not in the 2026 sample
gap: No separate evaluation of FMS controls yet
remediation: Pre-assessment of FMS controls by the internal audit firm before the observation period

control_description: Deficiencies tracked in the POA&M and reported to the COO monthly and the audit committee quarterly

topic_label: Control activities selected to mitigate risk
control_description: Control activities selected from the P01 risks and this readiness assessment
General IT controls in the landing zone (guardrails, federation, logging to archive) cover the FMS account
gap: FMS account has its own administrators outside the quarterly access review
remediation: Include FMS administrators in the quarterly review

topic_label: Control activities deployed through policies and procedures
control_description: POL-01 to POL-05 approved 2026-09-15; standards in draft
gap: STD-02, STD-07, STD-10 not yet issued
remediation: Issue on the P06 schedule (POAM-022)

topic_label: Logical access security software, infrastructure, architecture
control_description: Federated administrator sign-in with FIDO2 keys; mutual TLS for ingestion; tenant keys per utility; WAF on the portal
evidence: P04 rows for the FMS account
gap: Client certificates last 3 years without revocation checking (P01 R-027)
remediation: Revocation checking and 1-year certificates

control_description: Portal users requested by each utility's administrator; company staff through the HR-driven identity provider
evidence: Portal user export (260 users); request records (10 sampled)

control_description: Role-based access in the portal and analytics service
gap: No periodic review of portal users with each utility; FMS engineers hold broad database read rights
remediation: Quarterly portal user confirmation by each utility; narrow engineer rights

control_description: Cloud provider data centers (inherited, SOC 2); company offices badge-controlled
Encrypted storage with company-managed keys; deletion at contract end described in agreements
gap: No documented procedure or certificate for deleting a departing subscriber's data
remediation: Data return and deletion procedure with evidence

topic_label: Protection against threats from outside boundaries
control_description: Provider edge protection, WAF, and rate limits; no route from the FMS account to the ERP or plants

topic_label: Restriction of data transmission and movement
control_description: TLS for all ingestion and portal traffic; no bulk export feature in the portal

topic_label: Prevention and detection of unauthorized or malicious software
control_description: Container image scanning in the pipeline; EDR on FMS virtual machines
gap: Dependency scanning not enforced (findings do not block releases)
remediation: Blocking dependency scan under STD-10

topic_label: Detection of configuration changes and vulnerabilities
control_description: Monthly vulnerability scans and cloud posture checks cover the FMS account
gap: No penetration test of the portal or ingestion interface
remediation: Annual penetration test before the observation period (POAM-017)

topic_label: Monitoring for anomalies and security events
control_description: Gateway logs go to the archive. FMS application logs do not reach the SIEM and are not monitored
gap: FMS application and database events not monitored (P04 finding 3)
remediation: Onboard FMS logs to the SIEM with use cases (POAM-019)

control_description: MSSP triage for IT alerts; FMS events would reach nobody today
gap: No triage path for FMS-specific events
remediation: FMS use cases and escalation in the MSSP runbook

control_description: P08 runbook 2 covers FMS incidents and subscriber notice (effective 2026-10-01)
gap: Runbook not yet exercised
remediation: FMS scenario in the 2027-Q1 product compromise tabletop

control_description: No FMS recovery runbook; daily backups only
gap: Recovery from incidents not designed or tested for the FMS
remediation: FMS recovery runbook and restore test (POAM-019)

control_description: Code changes reviewed informally; model updates deployed by the data science lead without records
gap: No authorization, testing evidence, or approval for model and release changes
remediation: Change control for releases and AI-003 model updates (POAM-019; P10)

control_description: BIA covers the FMS (BP-14) with RTO 8 hours and RPO 1 hour
gap: Business disruption plan for the FMS not written
remediation: FMS section in the contingency plan (STD-07)

topic_label: Vendor and business partner risk management
control_description: Cloud provider and identity provider SOC 2 reports reviewed (Part B); TMU data platforms are the subscribers' own
gap: Subservice organization list and complementary subservice organization controls not yet written
remediation: Carve-out list and CSOC mapping in the system description

control_description: Capacity monitoring for ingestion, database, and portal with 40% headroom; autoscaling
Multi-zone database; daily backups to the backup account; provider environmental protections inherited
gap: Backups do not meet the 1-hour RPO; no continuous backup
remediation: Continuous backup (POAM-019)

control_description: No recovery test
gap: Recovery plan not tested
remediation: Restore test into an isolated account before 2027-04-01

control_description: Retention defined in agreements
gap: Disposal at subscription end not evidenced
